verdict.rationale: Logseq offers general-purpose integration plumbing that external AI tools could use: a third-party plugin marketplace with community plugin APIs, and a token-authenticated local HTTP API server with CORS and method dispatch. However, the evidence never shows an AI/LLM plugin or a first-party AI connector. One community user reports that Claude/Codex can no longer write or update pages in the new DB version, which suggests external-AI workflows rely on generic access and can break. Missing for 10: first-party LLM connectors, evidence of an actual AI plugin ecosystem, an MCP or LLM-oriented integration surface (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404), and stable external-AI access in the DB version.
